title: Delmarva Board Sports Watersports Concession
specs: Located right on the water in Dewey Beach behind the Bay Resort Waterfront Hotel
Water is waist to chest deep in most areas, suitable for beginners
Guided excursions are award winning and include instruction and photography when possible
Experienced paddle boarders must be at least 18 years old to launch without a guide
Children under 13-17 can paddle with a parent or guardian who signs a waiver and stays on site
A guide is required for children under 12
Paddleboards are considered vessels by USCG and Delaware law; life jackets and whistles are required
Children age 12 and younger must wear a USCG-approved life jacket at all times on a paddleboard
Group lessons require minimum 2 people for group price, otherwise private

blurb: Guests can rent paddleboards and kayaks by the hour or for multiple days, with all rentals including safety gear such as life jackets and whistles. Lessons and guided excursions are available daily, including group and private options, with all gear and photos included when possible. The business also offers delivery of gear locally and an indoor creative workshop option if weather cancels watersports.
